01 / OBSERVABLE

A measured vertical dimension

Height: mean RMS change of internal pair distances at a declared lag, in nm. This is structural mobility, not free energy.

Missing tiles mean insufficient support. Resampling intervals describe conditional spread; they are not calibrated confidence intervals. An inferred ancestral root need not be an independent preparation.

Each tile has a recorded representative, magnified independently of the quantitative height. Its geometry is not a probability density or a continuous molecular surface.

02 / OVERLAP CATEGORY

Mint: cover sets; blue: pair intersections; amber: triple intersections. Edges are strict inclusions; triangular plates are chains of two inclusions. The full witnessed complex is stored as maximal simplices; this display is a finite subcategory.

The nerve is lifted for visibility. Its vertical offset has no physical meaning. Unsupported vertices remain in the data but are omitted from this embedding.

03 / RECORDED DYNAMICS

Observed conformations

Playback steps through actual frames. Camera and illumination stay fixed. No synthetic intermediate conformers or continuous deformation law are inserted.
